items.title: What's Happening and What's Happening Now
items.description:

Yaya from the Cultura Latina Dance Academy comes onto What's Happening to discuss the organization's focus and upcoming event to be held at Lynn Arts on Tuesday, July 29. All proceeds will go to benefiting the Children's Dance Program.

For more info. visit www.culturalatinadance.com
